title: precheck names each committed item's goal clauses with the check that reads each, and warns of a clause no check reads
goal: Answers the SP-s5fdczv7 retrospective: all three code items (BG-m6fknqr5, BG-tyuwiin7, ST-dets7lkp) carried a check that read one clause of a several-clause goal (a source-order read, one command mapping, one cost header line), so the other clauses were proved only by the orchestrator and the reviewer, and BG-ese7wmz3 and BG-47kw57ed got through. backlog.py precheck SP prints, for each committed item, its goal's clauses (split as close --summary splits a sprint goal) and the check or repro that reads each, from a clauses mapping the planner records on the item (set ID --add-clause CLAUSE=N, N the index of the check or repro that reads it, validated by backlog.py check), and warns of a clause no check reads, so kb-sprint plan step 6 is a tool output, not a reading; kb-sprint plan step 6, backlog.md and tools.md say so.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,json,shutil;from pathlib import Path;live=os.getcwd();t=tempfile.mkdtemp();s.run(['git','init','-q',t],check=True);os.makedirs(t+'/kb/_self/backlog');b=[sys.executable,live+'/_tools/backlog.py','--root',t];run=lambda *a:s.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t);sp=run('new','sprint','--title','S').stdout.split()[2];st=run('new','story','--title','T','--sprint',sp,'--goal','the alpha reader works; the beta writer works','--check','python3 -c 1/0').stdout.split()[2];p=Path(t,'_backlog',st+'.json');d=json.loads(p.read_text());d['clauses']=[{'clause':'the alpha reader works','check':0}];p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2));out=run('precheck',sp).stdout.splitlines();w=[l for l in out if 'warning' in l];ok=any(st in l and 'beta writer' in l for l in w) and not any('alpha reader' in l for l in w);shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print(sp,st,out);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
t=tempfile.mkdtemp()
s.run(["git","init","-q",t],check=True)
os.makedirs(t+"/kb/_self/backlog")
b=[sys.executable,os.getcwd()+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",t]
run=lambda *a:s.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t)
sp=run("new","sprint","--title","S").stdout.split()[2]
st=run("new","story","--title","T","--sprint",sp,"--goal","the alpha reader works; the beta writer works","--check","python3 -c 1/0").stdout.split()[2]
ok=run("set",st,"--add-clause","the alpha reader works=0")
bad=run("set",st,"--add-clause","the beta writer works=7")
d=json.loads(Path(t,"_backlog",st+".json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
print("add-clause exit",ok.returncode,"| index 7 exit",bad.returncode,"| clauses",d.get("clauses"),(ok.stderr or "").strip()[-80:])
sys.exit(0 if ok.returncode==0 and bad.returncode!=0 and d.get("clauses")==[{"clause":"the alpha reader works","check":0}] else 1)
